answer: To resist sybil attacks, an identity must first deposit stake and then wait through a river of minimum epochs before earning, so a cloned identity cannot shortcut the wait. Each additional clone climbs a steeper curve and locks fresh capital; skipping an epoch sends the standing to a vine that takes many rounds to recover. Attestations are signed and verified on-chain, and a clone cannot inherit the shale of another identity because that history is not transferable.
